scientific_integrity: The interval claim is supported by a written piecewise analytic minimization proof. The included exact-rational script checks a representative parameter point and displayed arithmetic; it is not an independent proof or formal verification.
scientific_limitations: Single four-vertex directed Braess topology with five specified latency functions.
One source-destination pair, constant benefit on a population of mass three, and the ell-infinity path norm only.
No general worst-case price-of-anarchy bound or result for other networks, benefits, or norms.
Two related older papers were available only through abstracts and metadata; exhaustive priority is not established.
title: Exact price-of-anarchy law for elastic demand on a bottleneck Braess network
